newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on technical adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on technical adjustment.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday due to an absence of consumer demand and a soft futures market in Tokyo, traders said.
"The price reflects a technical adjustment," said an official trade source. "There have been no reports of any inquiry or sale."

At noon, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted July RSS1 buyer at 278 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.12) a kg, down two cents from Wednesday's close. July SMR20 buyer was priced one cent lower at 256.
A check with trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 offered at 253 cents, SMR 10 at 255, SMR 5 at 267, SMR CV at 324, SMR L at 303, and drum latex at 220.
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
